'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Mitch Nieland LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Rescue the princess skeet!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
